source: @aifinpay/gate src/challenge.ts buildChallenge and src/scope.ts scopeCovers (sdk d8725f4, the section page row from gate 0.9.1, the how_to_pay line from gate 0.10.0) with MIN_BATCH_UNITS 20_000

body.detail: Payment Required — prepay a batch of requests and retry with the AIFP-Receipt header
body.settlement_terms_from: POST https://api.aifinpay.io/v1/quote — returns accepted_chains, accepted_assets, amount, order_id and expiry
how_to_pay: POST https://api.aifinpay.io/v1/quote {"merchant_id":"mrch_45b1fb9572bdf4f3","resource":"/resources/*","tier":"standard","scope":"exact","requests":40,"payer":"<your wallet address>"} — payer is required; raise requests to buy more than the minimum batch; check amount, scope, expiry and payer before paying
settle the quoted batch on-chain from your own wallet (order_id = quote_id)

POST https://api.aifinpay.io/v1/pay {quote_id, chain, asset, tx_ref, payment_authorization} + Idempotency-Key header -> quota receipt (wallet-signature-v1). Keep the quote until you hold the receipt; on a timeout retry with the same key and tx_ref — never pay again
retry this request with headers: AIFP-Receipt: <receipt JWT> and AIFP-Agent-Id: <the address that paid>
body.no_wallet: npx @aifinpay/mcp init — creates or selects a local wallet; read instructions_url for supported clients and payment availability. Wallet setup alone does not enable settlement.
